value.rationale: Provides a direct counterexample to the precisely stated unrestricted Haar-optimality question of Aldous (2021/2022) for rate-one growing balls on a compact group. Contrasts homogeneous geometry with nonuniform optimality and identifies finiteness/topological disconnectedness as a key boundary; not merely a computational parameter substitution.
